topics.label: Lecture overview and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This opening subtopic outlines the scope of the lecture on cancer causes and defines the expected learning objectives.

topics.label: Conceptual frameworks and epidemiology of cancer etiology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the interplay between genetic predisposition, endogenous errors, environmental exposures, and geographical epidemiological evidence underlying cancer development.

topics.label: Mechanisms of specific carcinogens, tumor initiation, and promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine specific biological, chemical, and physical agents alongside the molecular mechanisms, metabolic activations, and tumor promotion processes that drive carcinogenesis.

topics.label: Methodologies for identifying and testing carcinogenicity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover genomic, epidemiological, animal, and in vitro experimental methods used to determine and validate whether exposures are carcinogenic.
